import sys

MOD = 998244353

def enum_fif(n, mod):
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod
    invf = [1] * (n + 1)
    invf[n] = pow(f[n], mod - 2, mod)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod
    return [f, invf]

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, K, L = map(int, data[:3])
    mod = MOD
    # We need factorials up to 2*n+1 because we use fif[1][2*i+1] for i up to n
    max_n = 2 * n + 1
    fif = enum_fif(max_n, mod)
    muls = [0] * (n + 1)
    for j in range(K, n + 1):
        c = C(n, j, mod, fif)
        sign = 1 if ((j + K) & 1) == 0 else -1
        comb = C(j - 1, K - 1, mod, fif)
        muls[j] = c * sign % mod * comb % mod
        if muls[j] < 0:
            muls[j] += mod
    ans = 0
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        term = pow(2, i, mod) * fif[0][i] % mod * fif[0][i] % mod
        term = term * fif[1][2 * i + 1] % mod * muls[i] % mod
        ans = (ans + term) % mod
    ans = ans * L % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
